He tucked the note into his coat, climbed the spiral stairs, and lit the lamp a little earlier than usual that night.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还在沉睡。街灯把空荡的马路照成一条安静的河，偶尔有出租车驶过，带起一阵冷风。早餐铺的卷帘门半开着，蒸汽从锅里升起，老板揉着面团，手上沾满白粉。清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面，发出沙沙的声响。天边泛起一丝灰蓝，楼宇的轮廓渐渐清晰。鸟还没叫，人还没醒，城市像一个深呼吸前的停顿，安静，却已经悄悄开始苏醒。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of itself.\n• Like looking into two mirrors facing each other, you see a smaller picture inside a picture, again and again.\n• It stops when the problem gets so small there's an easy answer, so it doesn't go on forever."}
